page.overview:
Who is Davy D. Jones?

Davy D. Jones, more commonly known as Davy Jones, was a legendary pirate from long ago who was said to have been cursed by a demon to live on the sea floor. Believed to have been driven by obsessive greed, the piracy plunder game known as the Davy Back Fight was dedicated to him.

The central figure of the Davy Family, he is the distant ancestor of Rocks D. Xebec, a self-proclaimed worshipper of his, as well as Xebec's son and only child, Marshall D. Teach. Xebec believed that Davy Jones was the King of the World at some point prior to being supplanted by Nerona Imu and the World Government.

Davy D. Jones lived sometime over 800 years ago, with his descendants having been targeted by the World Government for the past eight centuries. His descendant, Rocks D. Xebec, declared that Davy was "King of the World", however Nerona Imu has furiously denied this and rejected the notion of Davy being the king. It is unknown what became of Jones, but legend holds that he became cursed by the devil to live on the sea floor.

Jones became a legendary figure among pirates, but the "D." in his name was lost to history. Because of the legend around his fate, the sea floor is commonly known as Davy Jones' Locker, and Davy Jones is considered to "own" everything that sinks into the sea as it lands in his domain. Taking things from other pirates is known as "Davy Back". The Davy Back Fight is named after Davy Jones, and the spirit of the event lies in the participants' devotion to the figure as tributes of coins are made to him as a promise that the rules of the event are to be adhered to, lest anyone who breaks them be sent to the Locker. Rocks D. Xebec, as a Davy Jones worshipper, made frequent use of the Davy Back Fight to build up what became his crew.
